fields.value: CodePori: Large Scale System for Autonomous Software Development by Using Multi-Agents

dsDescriptionValue.value: This dataset accompanies the paper "CodePori: A Large-Scale System for Autonomous Software Development Using Multi-Agents." The dataset is recorded in an MS Excel file, which contains the following sheets, with a brief description of each provided below: Selected Projects: Contains the descriptions of the 20 selected projects along with the GitHub URL for each. Modifications: Contains details of the modifications made to the projects to ensure successful execution. Outputs: Contains the output for each project. Failed Projects: Contains data on the projects that failed. Code Execution: Contains instructions on how to execute the projects.
